findings.argument: The new helper matches only `PropertyDeclarationSyntax`. For `record R([property: Key(null)] string X)` the declaration is a `ParameterSyntax`, so the location is null, and the new filter drops the diagnostic. The base file already handles `ParameterSyntax` elsewhere.
findings.fix_hint: Handle `ParameterSyntax` in the helper, as the base file already does; report instead of dropping when the member is in source.

summary.what: Stops the source generator and analyzer from crashing on closed generic value types from a referenced assembly (MessagePack #2283) by making two syntax lookups null-safe — and, beyond the request, by silently dropping every analyzer warning that has no source location in the current project.
summary.verdict: Request changes is likely: the crash fix looks right, but the extra filter changes all analyzer warnings and may hide a real one (F1).
